editorial_review_row.author: NAFT Editorial
editorial_review_row.content: Capital.com holds triple Tier-1 regulatory licences — FCA (FRN 793714), CySEC (319/17), and ASIC — plus a MiCA licence and SCA (UAE) authorisation. Founded in 2016, it has grown to $1.27 trillion in quarterly trading volume without a single enforcement action, warning list placement, or fraud allegation. The $20 minimum deposit, commission-free spread-only pricing from 0.6 pips EUR/USD, no inactivity fee, and no withdrawal fees make it one of the most accessible triple Tier-1 brokers available. 5,585+ tradeable instruments — including the largest crypto CFD library among forex brokers — and AI-driven trading insights on a proprietary platform set it apart from legacy competitors. The Trustpilot rating of 4.8/5 from 1,900+ reviews is exceptional and among the highest in the industry. Concerns centre on the relatively short 9-year track record, absence of a raw-spread account option, no MT5 support, and the offshore SCB entity serving international clients without compensation scheme protection. The rapid growth trajectory raises long-term operational questions that only time can answer. But the regulatory credentials, pricing transparency, and user satisfaction metrics all point in the same direction — this is a legitimate, well-run broker that has earned its place among the industry's strongest names in under a decade.
